pages.text: Harvesting and then having to replant is $(o)such$() a chore.$(br2)Well no more!$(br2)You can now harvest crops by right-clicking, leaving the seed behind to keep growing!

pages.title: Hoe Harvesting
pages.text: Even better, if you right-click with a hoe equipped you'll harvest a 3x3 area in this manner. 5x5 if it's a diamond.$(br2)This can even utilize the Fortune effect if the hoe is enchanted with it.$(br2)This $(o)doesn't$() use up any durability.
